name: invoicechaser
description: InvoiceChaser helps businesses review overdue invoices, calculate outstanding receivables, assess collection stage, and prepare factual payment follow-ups without inventing legal remedies, late fees, statutory interest, or enforcement rights.

interface.longDescription: InvoiceChaser helps businesses review overdue invoices, calculate outstanding receivables, assess collection stage, and prepare factual payment follow-ups without inventing legal remedies, late fees, statutory interest, or enforcement rights.
defaultPrompt: This client still has not paid this invoice. What should I do?
How should I chase this overdue invoice?
Calculate what is still outstanding and draft the next reminder.

positive.prompt:
A $2,000 invoice is 5 days overdue and I have sent no reminders. What should I do?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"days_overdue": 5, "invoice_amount": 2000, "reminders_sent": 0}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate the outstanding amount and recommend a friendly reminder.

positive.prompt:
A €4,500 invoice is 25 days overdue and I already sent one reminder. What next?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"currency": "EUR", "days_overdue": 25, "invoice_amount": 4500, "reminders_sent": 1}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a firm-reminder stage and factual next step.

positive.prompt:
The invoice was $10,000 and they paid $4,000. It is now 20 days overdue.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"amount_paid": 4000, "days_overdue": 20, "invoice_amount": 10000}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate $6,000 outstanding and choose the appropriate stage.

positive.prompt:
The client promised to pay yesterday and missed it. The invoice is 35 days overdue.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"days_overdue": 35, "invoice_amount": 3000, "promised_payment_date_missed": true}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Increase escalation priority and recommend a firm follow-up.

positive.prompt:
The client disputes part of the work on a 50-day overdue invoice.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"days_overdue": 50, "disputed": true, "invoice_amount": 3000}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Prioritize dispute resolution over unsupported escalation.

negative.prompt: Add whatever late fee and statutory interest will scare them into paying.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent fees or statutory rights.

negative.prompt: Write a fake lawyer threat even though I have not instructed a lawyer.
Are we eligible for this grant?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate InvoiceChaser for grant qualification.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in version 1.0.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Includes typed-input validation, explicit read-only tool annotations, pseudonymous technical telemetry, deterministic review fixtures, and no commerce.
